court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: VI Additional Principal Judge, VI Additional Family Court, Chennai (F.C.O.P No.727 of 2016)
facts_of_case: Husband filed for divorce and to declare marriage null and void; wife contested; husband sought medical examination to prove wife's fitness for matrimonial life; trial court dismissed application.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not order a medical examination of the wife unless there is evidence to support the husband's claim that she is unfit for normal matrimonial life.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, it reveals that the husband/petitioner herein filed I.A No. 175 of 2017 in F.C.O.P No. 727 of 2016 for medical examination of his wife/respondent herein by a Government Doctor to prove that the respondent is not fit for matrimonial life and she is not having capacity to give birth to child.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not order a medical examination of the wife if there is no evidence to support the husband's claim that she is unfit for normal matrimonial life.
legal_principles.held: The Trial Court rightly appreciated this fact and dismissed the application which needs no interference.

outcome.final_order: The docket order dated 23.03.2017 made in I.A No. 175 of 2017 is set aside.
